quality_notes: Document is the HAL open-archive copy of Harmand et al. 2015, Nature 521:310-315 (21 pages: HAL cover, article, Extended Data, Methods). Text was extractable; no OCR needed. Figures and tables were not inspected visually. Numbers (149 artefacts, 13 m2, 3.1 kg mean core, 15 kg max, 47±9% woody cover, 3.31 Ma Toroto Tuff) are taken from the main text; I did not read the Methods/Supplementary in depth. The statement that some researchers later questioned LOM3 (natural breakage / more evidence needed) is from my own knowledge (e.g. Domínguez-Rodrigo & Alcalá 2016, PaleoAnthropology) and I did not cite it as a source because I am not fully sure of the bibliographic details; reviewer may verify and add. In e3 point 5 src is [2,0] = Villmoare 2015 (note added in proof of the paper) and the paper. The Dikika dispute (Domínguez-Rodrigo et al. 2010, PNAS) is also from memory and not cited. Leakey et al. 2001 Kenyanthropus is mentioned in people note only, not in sources. Person years for Louis Leakey are standard (1903-1972).
